# Stage 1 before/after — generated by calibration/stage1_before_after.py

Model weight 0.15, buffer 3 pp, devig shin. Historical predictions stored no prices: market taken at -110 both ways at the stored line. Log loss of a coin flip is 0.6931; Brier 0.25.

## Live predictions graded so far

Excluded: 19 baseline predictions (and their ML twins) generated after kickoff, against in-play lines. The old rule flagged 8 of them (6-2 (75%)); those results are not pregame picks.
